meta.title: Vendor view when event withdrawn
warnings: resolved: “Verify that the entire vendor view is read-only with no editable controls.” — switch_portal / vendor_open_event open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor in a second browser

steps.note: Open the API-prepared withdrawn event; prepared-state cases must start from its summary.
Switch to Vendor A's supplier-portal session while leaving the buyer session available.
Open the withdrawn event in the vendor portal and remain on its overview.
Verify the vendor sees that the event is withdrawn.
Verify the vendor is not offered the quote-submission control on the withdrawn event.
